purpose: Unified startup source, option, operand and support inventory of 79 commands and 12 core packages; no acceptance promotion
common_interpretation: Paths and one-based line ranges resolve at source_revision under source_root. Every row includes actual source plus declarations; declarations alone do not establish support.

Options list accepted parser spellings or expression grammar observed in source, including recognized rejection paths where identified. They are not a completed alias/conflict/repeat/error-precedence contract.
Common standalone metadata is --help and --version; exact invocation behavior remains command-specific. Catalog contract() appends these metadata entries at core/cli/catalog.mbt:1-27.

Generic cli.parse supports --, short clusters, attached values and long=value but keeps scanning options after operands; individual commands may normalize first or use independent parsers. Catalog names may be semantic identifiers, not literal accepted long aliases.
Current support labels are inherited declarations, not fresh GNU/POSIX, Native/Wasm, platform, published-consumer or performance verification.
Documented API boundaries are conditional current project policy, not fresh absence proofs of released dependency APIs. Algorithm work must not be relabeled as an API gap.
All rows still need applicable frozen-oracle option/operand/conflict/error-prefix/effect cases at their owning implementation stage. No oracle conflict was resolved by this inventory.
